newsitem.title: UK: Costain egm clears new Indonesian capital.
newsitem.headline: Costain egm clears new Indonesian capital.

text.p: An extraordinary general meeting at British construction group Costain Plc on Monday approved the allotment of new shares to Indonesian and Kuwaiti investors to allow the company to raise 5.4 million stg cash.

In a statement Costain said the moves would give Indonesian industrialist Hendri Luhur a 4.5 percent interest in the group and enable Kuwaiti construction company Mohamed Abdulmohsin Kharafi & Sons to maintain its shareholding at 25.35 percent.
Both investments had been planned late last year, but their completion will depend on the satisfactory conclusion of the sale of Costain's US Coal businesses and the relisting of its shares.
Its shares were suspended on November 7, pending asset transactions.
